newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. deducts $60 mln from Israel loan guarantees.
newsitem.headline: U.S. deducts $60 mln from Israel loan guarantees.

text.p: The United States will deduct only $60 million from Israel's annual $2 billion allotment of loan guarantees, Israel's Treasury said.
This figure is equivalent to the amount Israel invests in Jewish settlements in the West Bank and Gaza.

This is the second consecutive year that the United States will deduct only $60 million, considered to be a low amount. Israel will therefore be able to raise up to $1.94 billion with the use of guarantees in the U.S. fiscal year that began on October 1.
Finance Minister Dan Meridor said he was very pleased with the small deduction as in previous years much larger sums were deducted.
The total of $10 billion in loan guarantees runs out in 1998.
